description: Dunit musl port (M6) — first static program linked against the ported libc. userspace/ctests/musl_hello.c is built with the host compiler against the x86_64-dunit sysroot (toolchains/dunit-musl, built by build-libc.sh), using musl's real crt1 + __libc_start_main + __init_tls + the native SetThreadPointer, and calls write() over the Dunit syscall. /app/musl_hello is launched from the terminal; its stdout is mirrored to serial. Proves the ported musl starts and runs on the Green Tea Kernel. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_musl_hello_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 3 --timeout 140 --boot-timeout 90

required.claim: the system booted to the terminal
musl's crt1 + __libc_start_main + __init_tls + __set_thread_area (native SetThreadPointer) reached main() — the ported libc starts on the kernel
__libc_start_main derived argc/argv from the Dunit SysV initial stack and passed them to main
write() went through the ported libc to the native Dunit Write syscall and the program ran to a clean return
